nodes.name: description_label
nodes.text:
Processes UtilityCraft sieve recipes through a shared four-slot input pool and a reusable Mesh. Drops are rolled once per processed item and stored in the 15-slot output buffer.

Steam is optional. A boosted cycle consumes 125 units per processed item, runs at 150% rate, and costs 125% energy.

Item I/O:
§9Input§r exposes all material inputs.
§bMesh§r exposes the mesh slot.
§cOutput§r exposes the output buffer.

Gas I/O:
§9Steam Input§r accepts Steam.
